goal: Add a read-only material MCP server as the next roadmap item while preserving the existing uncommitted creative workflow changes.

implementation.transport: Local stdio, official MCP SDK v2.4.0; no network listener.
implementation.catalog: Reads the existing constants/tryOnMaterials.json from a fixed module-relative path; eight entries in three populated categories.
implementation.formats: Existing SVG references carry mimeType and requiresRasterization metadata; the brief explains conversion or use through the web app.
implementation.recipe: Uses the existing browser-compatible v1 try-on recipe format. Shared URLs contain catalog IDs and default settings, never custom brief text.
implementation.privacy: Does not read browser photos, keys, drafts, history or baskets, and does not call image providers.
implementation.configuration: BLOOMRENDER_SITE_URL controls the returned deployment base URL without fetching it. Credential-bearing URLs, queries and fragments are rejected.
implementation.dependencies: Server, client and Zod are development tooling dependencies. MCP modules are absent from the production browser manifest.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Verified current official SDK API and npm versions, inspected existing catalog/recipe contracts, then fixed tool input/output shapes.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: One implementation owner handled MCP modules/dependencies/docs; root independently authored real protocol and browser bridge tests; a separate reviewer audited the result.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Package files had one owner. No previous UI implementation files were modified by the MCP owner.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: One small read-only server plus independent verification, without a new web service or browser-side SDK integration.

protocolCases: Current SDK client handshake and calls from a foreign working directory
All four tools and advertised output schemas
Strict invalid arguments and conflicting references with server remaining alive
Custom prompt excluded from recipe URL
Invalid startup configuration sanitized with stdout empty

includes: Actual MCP-composed link opens the correct try-on materials without API requests
Removed references remain removed after reload
Open-dialog accessibility at 390 and 1440 in all three themes

verification.publicAssetProbe: HEAD for the canonical Oxford-shirt SVG returned HTTP 200 with image/svg+xml.
verification.review: Independent read-only review found no actionable new defect.
verification.layoutScope: This continuation adds local tooling and documentation only. The existing UI source was preserved; the prior creative-workflow GATE: PASS was not rerun.

deliveryAtVerification: Not registered in Codex settings, committed, pushed or deployed. The prior creative workflow changes remain in the working tree.
